chunks: Abu al-Hasan Musa ibn Ja'far عليهما السلام said:
"Indeed, salat in the first row is like jihad in the way of Allah, the Mighty and Majestic."

key_terms.الصَّفِّ الْأَوَّلِ: the first row in congregational prayer
key_terms.الْجِهَادِ: jihad, striving in the way of Allah
key_terms.سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ: the way of Allah, His cause and path
key_terms.عَزَّ وَجَلَّ: the Mighty and Majestic, an honorific for Allah

ai.seo_question: What is the virtue of praying in the first row in congregational salat?
ai.summary: This hadith extols the virtue of standing in the first row for congregational salat. It emphasizes the great spiritual merit of promptness, devotion, and eagerness in worship by likening it to jihad in the way of Allah, the Mighty and Majestic.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1140 - Abu Al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim (as) said:
"Praying in the first row is like striving (jihad) in the way of Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic."
